title: EnvironmentTemplateResource

id.description: The ID of the reusable environment template.

name.description: An optional human-readable display name for the template.

created_at.description: The Unix timestamp, in seconds, when the template was created.

packages.description: Packages installed in each fresh OpenAI-hosted environment.

desktop.description: Desktop configuration for each OpenAI-hosted environment.

capability_directories.description: Directories that expose capabilities to the agent.

skills.description: Safe skill metadata, preserving unresolved version selectors.

plugins.description: Safe plugin metadata, excluding inline archive contents.

files.description: Safe file metadata, excluding contents and session-scoped file IDs.

description: Reusable configuration that provisions a fresh OpenAI-hosted environment for each session.
